name: infomap
reference: Rosvall & Bergstrom. Maps of random walks on complex networks reveal community structure. PNAS 2008. (infomap package)

num_trials.doc: Number of restart trials; the best-codelength partition is kept. The map equation itself is parameter-free (Markov time 1). A compute/robustness knob, not a tuned hyperparameter: set-only, default 1 (the tool default). Raise it in Protocol B for more stable results.
